links.outcome: Agreement of eight correctness criteria with two-reviewer human annotation; effect on UE ranking
links.effect: Criterion choice changed error-detection AUROC by up to 0.146 and reversed UE method rankings; exact matching had highest human agreement and lowest UE distortion; LLM-judge accepted 16 of 30 human-identified errors.
links.quote: Across four UE methods and 23,254 clinical predictions, criterion choice changed error-detection AUROC by up to 0.146 and reversed the relative ranking of UE methods.

unlisted_practices: Validating the correctness criterion against human judgement before comparing uncertainty estimation methods

screen.reason: Evaluates methods for uncertainty estimation and criteria for error/reliability detection in clinical vision-language model predictions, testing safeguards for identifying unreliable outputs.

primary.practice: uncertainty estimation evaluation and correctness criterion validation
